statement.name: GetNotificationTaskByName
statement.sql: SELECT NT.TaskId AS TaskId, NT.TaskName AS TaskName, NT.StatusCode AS StatusCode, NTS.ShortDisplayValue AS Status, NT.ComponentStrategyType AS ComponentStrategyType, NTD.TaskDetailId AS TaskDetailId, NTD.TaskSequence AS TaskSequence, NTD.DeliveryTypeCode AS DeliveryTypeCode, NTT.ShortDisplayValue AS DeliveryType, NTD.ComponentType AS ComponentType, NTD.StatementName AS StatementName, NTD.StatementLocation AS StatementLocation, NTD.MessageContextCode AS StandardMessageId, NTD.ComponentTransformationType AS ComponentTransformationType FROM NotificationTasks NT JOIN NotificationTaskDetails NTD ON NTD.TaskId = NT.TaskId JOIN LookupNotificationTaskStatus NTS ON NTS.LookupCode = NT.StatusCode JOIN LookupNotificationDeliveryType NTT ON NTT.LookupCode = NTD.DeliveryTypeCode WHERE NT.TaskName = ORDER BY NTD.TaskSequence

statement.name: GetNotificationSubscribers
statement.sql: IF OBJECT_ID ('AC_RelUserRole','U') IS NOT NULL BEGIN IF = 0 BEGIN SELECT PP.PersonId AS PersonId, PP.FirstName AS FirstName,PP.MiddleName AS MiddleName , PP.LastName AS LastName, CA.ContactAddress AS EmailAddress FROM AC_RelUserRole ACR JOIN People PP ON PP.UserId = ACR.UserId JOIN ContactAddresses CA ON CA.EntityId = PP.PersonId AND CA.ContactAddressTypeCode = 1 /* Email address */ WHERE ACR.RoleId = (SELECT SubscriberValue FROM NotificationSubscribers NSB WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(36), TaskDetailId) = AND SubscriberType = 1) /* Role based subscriber */ UNION SELECT PP.PersonId AS PersonId, PP.FirstName AS FirstName,PP.MiddleName AS MiddleName , PP.LastName AS LastName, CA.ContactAddress AS EmailAddress FROM People PP JOIN ContactAddresses CA ON CA.EntityId = PP.PersonId AND CA.ContactAddressTypeCode = 1 /* Email address */ WHERE PP.PersonId = (SELECT SubscriberValue FROM NotificationSubscribers NSB WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(36), TaskDetailId) = AND SubscriberType = 2) /* Person based subscriber */ END END IF OBJECT_ID ('AC_RelUserRole','U') IS NOT NULL BEGIN IF = 1 BEGIN SELECT PP.PersonId AS PersonId, PP.FirstName AS FirstName,PP.MiddleName AS MiddleName , PP.LastName AS LastName, CA.ContactAddress AS EmailAddress FROM AC_RelUserRole ACR JOIN People PP ON PP.UserId = ACR.UserId JOIN ContactAddresses CA ON CA.EntityId = PP.PersonId AND CA.ContactAddressTypeCode = 1 /* Email address */ WHERE ACR.RoleId = (SELECT SubscriberValue FROM NotificationSubscribers NSB WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(36), TaskDetailId) = AND SubscriberType = 1) /* Role based subscriber */ END END IF OBJECT_ID ('AC_RelUserRole','U') IS NOT NULL BEGIN IF = 2 BEGIN SELECT PP.PersonId AS PersonId, PP.FirstName AS FirstName,PP.MiddleName AS MiddleName , PP.LastName AS LastName, CA.ContactAddress AS EmailAddress FROM People PP JOIN ContactAddresses CA ON CA.EntityId = PP.PersonId AND CA.ContactAddressTypeCode = 1 /* Email address */ WHERE PP.PersonId = (SELECT SubscriberValue FROM NotificationSubscribers NSB WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(36), TaskDetailId) = AND SubscriberType = 2) /* Person based subscriber */ END END IF = 3 OR = 4 OR = 5 BEGIN SELECT SubscriberLocator AS SubscriberLocator, SubscriberLocatorType AS SubscriberLocatorType FROM NotificationSubscribers NSB JOIN NotificationCustomSubscriber NCS ON NCS.CustomId = NSB.SubscriberValue WHERE CONVERT(VARCHAR(36), TaskDetailId) = AND SubscriberType = /* Custom based subscriber, Carbon copy subscriber, Blind carbon copy subscriber */ END
